faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about privacy, language support, and system onboarding.

items.q: How does MediCore protect clinic and patient data?
items.a: MediCore is designed with privacy and security as core principles: each clinic's data is isolated from other clinics, access is controlled by user role, and sensitive actions are logged. Legal and data-protection requirements differ by country, so we're happy to walk you through our approach during a demo.

items.q: Does MediCore support Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. The whole interface works in Arabic (right-to-left) and English (left-to-right), and you can switch at any time.

items.q: Does MediCore work on tablets (iPads) and front-desk computers?
items.a: Yes. MediCore is cloud-based and responsive. It operates smoothly across desktop browsers (Mac, Windows) and tablets without requiring local server setups.

items.q: How easy is it for clinic staff to get onboarded?
items.a: MediCore is built around simple daily screens for reception, doctors, and accounting. We'll walk your team through it during your demo.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Notice
privacyPolicy.draftNotice: This notice is a draft pending legal review.
intro: This notice explains how MediCore handles personal data collected through this website when you contact us or request a demo.

It does not cover patient or medical data that clinics enter into the MediCore platform. That data is handled under the service agreement and a data processing agreement with each clinic, and the clinic is responsible for it toward its patients.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The organization named under “Contact us” at the end of this notice decides how and why your personal data is used, as described here.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: When you request a demo, we collect only what you type into the form:
list: Your specialty (chosen from a list, or typed by you if you select “Other”)
The language of the site you used (English or Arabic)
Your consent to be contacted, and the date and time you sent the request
after: Please do not enter patient information or any health data in the form.

Like any website, the provider that hosts this site automatically receives technical data when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the time of the request. We use it to keep the site secure and to limit abuse of the form.

If you contact us directly by email or WhatsApp, we receive your email address or phone number and the content of your message, and we use them only to reply. Your email or WhatsApp provider processes these messages under its own terms. Please do not send patient information by email or WhatsApp.

sections.title: Why we use your data
list: reply to your request and arrange a demonstration;
contact you about MediCore, as you agreed when you sent the form;
protect the website and the form against abuse.
after: We rely on your consent for contacting you, which you give by ticking the box in the form and can withdraw at any time. Keeping the site secure is in our legitimate interest.
We do not use your data for advertising, and we do not make automated decisions about you.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: This site stores two small items in your browser, only to remember choices you make:

rows: Until you clear your browser data

after: We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and this site loads no third-party scripts or fonts.

sections.title: Who receives your data
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with:
list: hosting and infrastructure providers that run this website;
the service provider that receives demo requests and delivers them to us;
authorities, only when the law requires us to disclose data.
after: These providers handle data on our behalf and only for the purposes above.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep demo requests for up to 12 months after our last contact with you, then delete them. If you become a customer, your details are kept under the service agreement instead.
The hosting provider keeps technical logs for a short period under its own retention rules.

sections.title: Where data is processed
paragraphs: Our providers may process data in other countries. Where the law requires it, we use appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: This site is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and form submissions are checked on the server and protected against automated abuse. No system is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your data.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have the right to:
list: access the data we hold about you;
restrict or object to some uses of your data;
receive a copy of your data in a portable format;
withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting earlier processing.
after: To use these rights, contact us using the details below. We may ask you to confirm your identity. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.
If you are a patient of a clinic that uses MediCore, please contact that clinic about your medical data.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: This website is for healthcare professionals and is not directed at children.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: We may update this notice. The date at the top shows the latest version, and we will point out significant changes on this page.
